exposure: Delivery assisted by a traditional birth attendant
cohort: 517 mothers of infants under 7 months old (234 urban and 283 rural)
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding was uncommon, with most mothers ceasing within 1 week after birth, and adequate information about EBF from health professionals around delivery seems to encourage its use.
mod_finding: In urban areas, EBF was more likely in mothers with problems with delivery including Caesarean section (AOR 3.60; 95% CI 1.17, 11.01).
